items.item: All 11 NBA Game Totals left blank ('—')
items.detail: Official 2025-26 NBA standings on nba.com publish W, L, Home and Road records without points scored/conceded per team. Moneyline and spread are originated from prior-season records; totals are deliberately left blank rather than estimated.

items.item: All 11 NBA picks capped at Medium confidence
items.detail: Every club on the 21 October NBA card enters 2026-27 at 0-0. Because lines rely on completed 2025-26 records prior to off-season roster movement taking effect on court, confidence is strictly capped at 'medium'.

items.item: 9 of 11 WST Northern Ireland Open R2 matches left unlined ('—')
items.detail: World Snooker Tour's official rankings page renders ranks #1–#36 server-side and loads #37+ dynamically. Only the two all-Top-36 ties (Higgins #6 vs Jak Jones #24; Zhang Anda #21 vs Mark Williams #8) are priced; the 9 ties with a #37+ player keep rank and odds blank.

ATP Tour renders singles ranks #1–#100 server-side (7 Top-100 matches priced). WTA singles rankings render client-side and ATP ranks > #100 require dynamic pagination, so those 8 matches keep player points and prices blank.
Clubs have played only M=1 match in 2026/27 (N=1 is insufficient to originate independent prices) and plusliga.pl/table.html redirects to the shared PLS tauronliga.pl template.

ICC match centres confirm the fixtures (274658, 271646, 269791) in page metadata, while team rating tables and scorecards render 'Loading' client-side. No secondary cricket site was used as a substitute.

items.item: 11 EHF CL venues & 4 EuroCup venues left blank ('—')
items.detail: Only venues explicitly confirmed on opened official match pages (Arena Zagreb for Zagreb–PSG and the 10 EuroLeague arenas) are populated; unverified venues remain blank.
PGA/DP World Tour 132-man strokes-gained feeds, 2027 pre-roster NRL/Super League futures, and county GAA club tables are not publicly server-rendered; fixtures are linked and prices left blank.

items.item: FLA/OTT team inputs exclude their still-live 21-Oct game
items.detail: The NHL Stats REST summary and standings were read on 2026-10-22 at ~01:35Z while PHI @ BUF (2-1 PHI after two periods) and FLA @ OTT (3-1 OTT after two periods) were still LIVE on the official Score API. Florida and Ottawa play again on 22 Oct, so their inputs are one in-progress game behind; the effect is bounded (one game of 10) and is disclosed rather than estimated from a live score.

items.item: EuroCup Round 5 and ATP next-round fixtures not captured on 2026-10-22
items.detail: The four BKT EuroCup R4 games were completed on 21 Oct and are retired; the EuroCup game-center page read on 2026-10-22 did not expose a server-rendered Round 5 fixture list in the chunks fetched, so EuroCup carries no rows until a later session captures Round 5 (due ~27-28 Oct). The same applies to ATP quarter-final orders of play (see VF-04). Neither gap was filled from secondary sources.

items.item: PDC ranking ladder retained from 21-Oct capture
items.detail: pdc.tv/rankings read on 2026-10-22 returned a cookie-consent wall with no server-rendered ladder rows in the fetched content. The 21-Oct captured Werner Ranking Ladder values are retained because no PDC ranking event has been completed between the two captures (the European Championship itself starts on the evening of 22 Oct); flagged so the next session re-reads the ladder after the event.

The six 21-Oct cards (Harlow, Monmore, Nottingham, Kinsley) are completed and retired. Trap sectional ratings require a licensed GBGB data feed and no 22-Oct card was captured from an official source in this refresh, so the Greyhounds page currently lists zero rows rather than stale ones.

items.item: 0 live events on OLBG hubs on 2026-10-21
items.detail: Both hubs were fetched directly on 2026-10-21 and returned 'No tips found' (AFL off-season; between LoL Worlds knockout stages on OLBG). Dedicated sport pages confirm the empty check without inventing fixtures.

items.item: Viewer-timezone rendering, abbreviated names & cached global /betting-tips cards
items.detail: OLBG hub pages display kick-offs in US Eastern time on US runners (e.g. 12:45 vs 18:45 CEST for EHF Handball), abbreviate club names ('Eire Og Cor'), and cache stale soccer cards on the global /betting-tips landing page.
